lines.text: Every pot in history began the same way.
A lump of wet clay. A spinning wheel. And a pair of hands.
Paanai is a daily pottery game that lives inside a Reddit post.
lines.say: Pah-nye is a daily pottery game that lives inside a Reddit post.

lines.text: Every day, the subreddit gets one commission: a real vessel from a real tradition. A Korean moon jar. A Song dynasty meiping. A Tamil paanai.
lines.say: Every day, the subreddit gets one commission: a real vessel from a real tradition. A Korean moon jar. A Song dynasty may-ping. A Tamil pah-nye.

lines.text: And everyone throws the same pot.
Tap Open, and the clay opens on the wheel.
Then it is one natural gesture. Drag up the wall to pull the clay taller. Drag sideways to swell the belly, or squeeze in a neck.
A glowing outline shows the shape you are chasing, and the Done button lights up the moment your pot passes.
And the clay behaves like clay. It dries as you work. It thins as it rises. Push it too far, and it wobbles, and collapses.
Tap Done, and the server takes over.
It replays every stroke from a fresh lump of clay, and scores the shape, the evenness of the walls, and the rules of the commission. Nobody can fake a score.
Your first throw of the day goes on the leaderboard.
Now make it yours. Paint bands, patterns, the body and the rim, straight onto the turning pot.
Then into the kiln. Every pot in the subreddit fires together, overnight. Thin walls can crack, and the glaze is a surprise.
Your very first pot gets a ten second test firing, so a new player sees the whole loop on their first visit.
Open the kiln, and see what the fire made.
Put your best pots on show. Rate them, like them, and share yours to the day's post with a single tap. The most loved becomes Pot of the Week.
Discover twenty four glazes in the Codex, and climb a hundred levels, each one a vessel to master.
Under the hood, Paanai runs on Devvit Web. Three dot j s renders the wheel. Hono and Redis run the server. And an integer only shaping core makes every replay exact.
lines.say: Under the hood, Pah-nye runs on Devvit Web. Three dot j s renders the wheel. Hoh-no and Redis run the server. And an integer only shaping core makes every replay exact.

lines.text: Every level and every daily vessel is tested to be finishable with one gesture.
Paanai. Throw it. Paint it. Fire it, together.
lines.say: Pah-nye. Throw it. Paint it. Fire it, together.
